name: E-Waste Collection Drive 2025
setup: The National Service Scheme (NSS) Unit of VIIT, in collaboration with Unnat Bharat Abhiyan (UBA) and the Leo Club Pune, successfully organized an E-Waste Collection Drive on 1st October 2025. Collection booths with NSS and UBA banners were set up at 9:00 AM, and awareness campaigns were conducted across departments.
text: The drive aimed to create awareness about responsible disposal of electronic waste and encourage sustainable recycling practices. In collaboration with authorized recycling partners, volunteers collected obsolete electronic items, cables, and components, ensuring environmentally safe processing and preventing hazardous landfill contamination.

name: Rakta-Setu — Mega Blood Donation Camp 2025
setup: Organized by NSS VIIT in association with Adhar Blood Bank and supported by faculty advisors. Pre-event street play 'Paristhitichi Janiv' was performed to mobilize student participation. 11 specialized free diagnostic desks including ECG, dental examination, and hemoglobin screening were arranged.
text: The flagship two-day blood donation drive achieved unprecedented student and faculty participation with 956+ participants and 385 verified units of blood collected. Alongside blood donation, certified medical professionals conducted cancer awareness sessions and health screenings for underprivileged staff and students.

name: Gram-Setu — NSS Residential Camp 2026
setup: A dedicated contingent of 60+ student volunteers was deployed for 8 days at Jamgaon, Mulshi. Structured committees managed field engineering tasks, village surveys, food logistics, school teaching modules, and guest lecture coordination.
text: The landmark Gram-Setu 2026 camp featured watershed drainage management at Disali School, daily morning yoga, a traditional Dindi procession, and a headline address by Padma Shri Popatrao Pawar (Hiware Bazar). The camp reinforced Jamgaon's 5-year streak of 100% 10th-grade board exam success through continuous volunteer tutoring.

name: Rakhi-With-Khaki — Honoring Police Personnel 2025
setup: Volunteers assembled handmade Rakhis and greeting messages in advance. NSS teams coordinated with police officials to schedule visits across multiple shifts, ensuring all on-duty personnel could be honored.
text: NSS VIIT volunteers visited local police stations to tie Rakhis to on-duty police officers and personnel in celebration of Raksha Bandhan. The initiative expressed deep civic gratitude for the tireless 24/7 service and sacrifices made by law enforcement officers to protect citizens.

name: Personality Development & Menstrual Hygiene Workshop 2025
setup: Organized under student welfare and NSS initiatives. Medical and counseling experts were invited as guest speakers. Informational brochures and sanitary hygiene kits were prepared for attendees.
text: A comprehensive workshop covering holistic personality development, public speaking, self-confidence, and menstrual hygiene health. Healthcare professionals demystified myths surrounding women's health and encouraged open dialogue on mental wellness and physical hygiene.

name: 79th Independence Day Celebration & Flag Hoisting 2025
setup: NSS volunteers organized the ceremonial flag hoisting parade, sound arrangements, patriotic cultural stage setup, and crowd discipline for institute dignitaries, faculty, and students.
text: A grand commemoration of India's 79th Independence Day featuring the ceremonial flag hoisting by college leadership, disciplined march past, patriotic poetry recitations, and inspiring addresses on national integration, youth responsibility, and civic duty.

name: Annual State-Level Youth Debate Competition 2025
setup: Multi-round debate setup with eminent adjudicators. Topics spanned technological ethics, environmental conservation policies, and social equity in modern India.
text: A spirited intellectual battle featuring debaters from engineering and degree colleges across Pune. Participants articulated compelling viewpoints on pressing contemporary socio-economic challenges, promoting critical thinking and parliamentary debate etiquette.

name: Srujanrang — Cultural & Folk Arts Competition 2025
setup: Stage lighting, sound engineering, traditional props, and judges' panel coordinated by NSS creative and event management teams.
text: A vibrant celebration of Maharashtra's rich cultural heritage featuring folk music, traditional dance, drama, and art. The festival provided student volunteers and participants a dynamic platform to showcase creative talents while celebrating unity in diversity.

name: Suraksha-Setu — Special Police Officer (SPO) Deployment 2025
venue: Swargate & Pune City Ganesh Visarjan Routes
setup: 122+ trained NSS volunteers were formally issued Special Police Officer badges and uniforms by Swargate Police Station. Deployed in synchronized shifts along heavy crowd corridors.
text: In an intensive 17-hour public safety initiative during the Anant Chaturdashi Ganesh Visarjan procession, NSS VIIT volunteers assisted city police in crowd management, traffic diversion, lost-and-found operations, and emergency medical corridors, winning official praise from law enforcement.

name: Naam Foundation Rural Development & Tree Drive 2025
setup: Logistics partnership with Naam Foundation. Saplings, compost, tools, and irrigation equipment mobilized with support from village panchayat representatives.
text: Collaborative environmental and farmer support initiative with Naam Foundation, focusing on water soil conservation, planting native drought-resistant trees, and supporting sustainable agro-farming techniques in water-stressed rural belts.

name: Faculty Development Program (FDP) on Community Engagement 2025
setup: Institutional academic workshop arranged for professors and NSS coordinators. Keynote speakers delivered lectures on integrating community immersion into technical curricula.
text: A 3-day Faculty Development Program bridging technical higher education with grassroots social challenges. Academic experts shared actionable frameworks for engineering students to design practical technological solutions for rural farming and municipal sanitation.

name: Swachhata Hi Seva — Mega Cleanliness Drive 2025
venue: VIIT Main Gate & Kondhwa Vicinity, Pune
setup: Organized under the national Swachh Bharat mission in collaboration with Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC). Protective gear, waste collection bags, and sanitization kits were distributed.
text: Volunteers undertook a high-impact cleanliness and plastic eradication drive around the VIIT campus and surrounding neighborhoods, collecting and segregating dry and wet waste while educating shopkeepers and residents on civic hygiene.
